tweaks.description: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar.

tweaks.name: Disable Snap Assist Suggestions

tweaks.name: Disable LLMNR
tweaks.description: Disables Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution to reduce attack surface.

tweaks.name: Disable NetBIOS over TCP/IP
tweaks.description: Disables legacy NetBIOS name resolution on all adapters.

tweaks.name: Enable DNS over HTTPS
tweaks.description: Configures DNS-over-HTTPS for supported resolvers.

tweaks.name: Disable Wi-Fi Sense
tweaks.description: Disables automatic connection to suggested open hotspots.

tweaks.name: Limit QoS Packet Scheduler Reservation
tweaks.description: Reduces the reserved bandwidth percentage from 20% to 0%.

tweaks.name: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
tweaks.description: Disables SysMain — recommended only for low-RAM or SSD-only systems.

tweaks.name: Disable Xbox Services
tweaks.description: Disables Xbox-related background services for non-gamers.

tweaks.name: Disable DiagTrack Service
tweaks.description: Disables the Connected User Experiences and Telemetry service.

tweaks.name: Disable WMP Network Sharing Service
tweaks.description: Disables Windows Media Player Network Sharing.

tweaks.name: Disable Fax Service
tweaks.description: Disables the legacy Fax service on systems without fax hardware.

tweaks.name: Disable Downloaded Maps Manager
tweaks.description: Disables MapsBroker for systems that don't use offline maps.

tweaks.name: Disable Game Bar
tweaks.description: Disables the Xbox Game Bar overlay.

tweaks.name: Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling
tweaks.description: Enables HAGS for supported GPUs to reduce latency.

tweaks.name: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations (Global)
tweaks.description: Disables fullscreen optimizations which can add input latency in some games.

tweaks.name: Disable Dynamic Tick / HPET
tweaks.description: Disables the High Precision Event Timer for reduced micro-stutter on some CPUs.

tweaks.name: Disable Hibernation
tweaks.description: Disables hibernation and removes hiberfil.sys to reclaim disk space.

tweaks.name: Disable Fast Startup
tweaks.description: Disables Fast Startup which can interfere with dual-boot and driver updates.

tweaks.name: Disable USB Selective Suspend
tweaks.description: Prevents USB devices from being suspended to save power, useful for peripherals.

tweaks.name: Maximize Processor Power Management
tweaks.description: Sets minimum processor state to reduce ramp-up latency under load.

tweaks.name: Disable Explorer Ads & Tips
tweaks.description: Removes suggestions and sync provider ads inside File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Hide Recent Files in Quick Access
tweaks.description: Stops recently used files from appearing in Quick Access.

tweaks.name: Remove OneDrive from Explorer
tweaks.description: Hides the OneDrive entry from File Explorer's navigation pane.

tweaks.name: Limit Thumbnail Cache Size
tweaks.description: Caps the thumbnail cache database size to reclaim disk space over time.

tweaks.name: Disable NTFS Last Access Updates
tweaks.description: Stops NTFS from stamping last-access timestamps on every read — reduces disk writes on SSDs.

tweaks.name: Enable Large System Cache
tweaks.description: Caches recently used files aggressively in RAM for faster repeat access.

tweaks.name: Enable Verbose Boot Messages
tweaks.description: Shows detailed status messages during boot — useful for diagnosing slow startups.

tweaks.name: Disable TDR (Timeout Detection & Recovery)
tweaks.description: Disables the GPU driver timeout watchdog — can fix stutters but may freeze the screen on driver hangs.

tweaks.name: Disable Spectre/Meltdown Mitigations
tweaks.description: Turns off CPU speculative-execution mitigations for maximum throughput — security trade-off.

tweaks.name: MMCSS Gaming Priority Profile
tweaks.description: Boosts GPU scheduling priority for the Games multimedia class (AtlasOS-style gaming tweak).

tweaks.name: Disable Power Throttling
tweaks.description: Prevents Windows from throttling background app CPU usage (AtlasOS power tweak).

tweaks.name: Disable Nagle's Algorithm
tweaks.description: Disables Nagle's algorithm and ACK delay on TCP interfaces — reduces latency in games.

tweaks.name: Disable Network Throttling Index
tweaks.description: Raises the network throttling index to unlimited — removes bandwidth reservation for multimedia.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Search
tweaks.description: Disables the Windows Search service — frees RAM and disk I/O on systems that don't use search indexing.

tweaks.name: Disable Retail Demo Experience
tweaks.description: Disables the RetailDemo service used in store display units.

tweaks.name: Disable Remote Registry
tweaks.description: Disables the Remote Registry service — a common attack surface on networked machines.

tweaks.name: Disable Delivery Optimization
tweaks.description: Disables peer-to-peer Windows Update delivery — updates download only from Microsoft.

tweaks.name: Disable Print Spooler
tweaks.description: Disables the Print Spooler service — also eliminates the PrintNightmare attack surface.

tweaks.name: Disable Connected Devices Platform
tweaks.description: Disables CDPSvc used for Phone Link, nearby sharing, and some casting features.

tweaks.name: Disable Sensor Service
tweaks.description: Disables the Sensor Service — stops sensor data collection on desktops.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Insider Service
tweaks.description: Disables the Windows Insider program service — reduces background polling.

tweaks.name: Disable Bing Search in Start
tweaks.description: Disables Bing web suggestions inside the Start menu search box.

tweaks.name: Disable Consumer Experiences & Suggestions
tweaks.description: Disables silent app installs, 'Get Office' prompts, and Windows Spotlight suggestions (CTT-style).

tweaks.name: Disable Web Search (Bing)
tweaks.description: Disables the Bing web-search integration in the local search index.

tweaks.name: Enable Storage Sense Auto Cleanup
tweaks.description: Automatically cleans temp files and recycle bin contents monthly.

tweaks.name: Disable Gallery in File Explorer
tweaks.description: Hides the new Gallery entry from the File Explorer navigation pane (Windows 11 23H2+).
